purpose: Teach: 変貌/賛美/洞察/バリュー/感度/時速/不必要/インタフェース

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪手口の変貌を捕捉されますね
lines.en: The police are really good at tracking how crime methods evolve, aren't they?
lines.style: Conversational, observant tone. Mild rising inflection on the question particle. Not flattering—genuinely acknowledging competence. Steady, measured pace. Thoughtful pause before speaking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民の善行を賛美されますね
lines.en: And they recognize citizens who do the right thing, don't they?
lines.style: Warm, approving quality. Slightly brighter than the previous line. Still measured. A small nod of respect embedded in the delivery. Light on the particle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の心理洞察に長けておられますね
lines.en: They have a real talent for reading suspects—understanding what they're thinking.
lines.style: Quieter, more thoughtful. Respectful of the skill being named. Slight lean forward in posture. Steady eye contact with the conversational partner. Measured, careful word choice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯行のバリュー、つまり動機の価値判断もされますね
lines.en: And they weigh the value of a crime too—I mean, understanding the motive behind it.
lines.style: Clarifying tone. Slight stumble on 'value'—correcting himself to explain better. Self-aware, not defensive. Conversational rhythm, like he's thinking aloud with someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯カメラの感度を上げられますね
lines.en: Security cameras—they can increase the sensitivity, can't they?
lines.style: Practical observation. Neutral tone, not particularly emphatic. Slight questioning lilt at the end. Matter-of-fact, like noting a technical capability. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、緊急車両は時速制限を超える事もありますね
lines.en: And emergency vehicles can exceed the speed limit when they need to.
lines.style: Straightforward statement. Light understanding tone—acknowledging necessity without judgment. Even pace. No dramatization. Factual delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、不必要な拘束は避けられますね
lines.style: Quiet approval. Gentle confirmation seeking. A slight warmth—affirming restraint and good judgment. Measured, calm delivery. Appreciative undertone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民通報インタフェースを整備されますね
lines.en: And they have good systems for citizens to report things.
lines.style: Genuine warmth now. Slight shift—more personal, closer to the listener. Acknowledging partnership between police and community. Softer pace. A small smile in the voice.
